items.title: File Einspruch against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung beim Landkreis Musteruckermark – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: This Bußgeldbescheid was formally served (förmliche Zustellung, Zustellungsurkunde nach § 182 ZPO), shown on the attached envelope copy as 'zugestellt am 24.11.2026' (Tuesday). For formal service there is no deemed-delivery fiction; the two-week Einspruch period of § 67 Abs. 1 OWiG runs from the actual service date. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB (via § 43 StPO/§46 Abs.1 OWiG) the day of service itself (24.11.2026) is not counted; counting starts 25.11.2026. Two weeks (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) later is Tuesday 08.12.2026. That day is a normal working day in Brandenburg (no weekend/holiday shift needed), so the Einspruch must be received by the Bußgeldstelle no later than 08.12.2026.

items.title: Pay the fine (Gesamtbetrag) once the Bescheid is final
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: The fine only becomes due once the Bescheid is rechtskräftig (final), which happens if no Einspruch is filed within the two-week period ending 08.12.2026. Rechtskraft therefore occurs on the following day, 09.12.2026 (assuming no Einspruch is lodged). Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of that event is not counted, so the two-week payment period starts 10.12.2026 and ends (§ 188 Abs. 1, 2 BGB) on Wednesday 23.12.2026, a normal working day in Brandenburg, so no shift applies. This date is contingent: if an Einspruch is filed by 08.12.2026, the Bescheid does not become final on this schedule and no payment falls due by this calculation.

warnings: The payment due date (23.12.2026) assumes no Einspruch is filed within the two-week period ending 08.12.2026; if an Einspruch is lodged, the fine does not become due on that schedule and the case instead proceeds to the Amtsgericht.

The sender's email address uses the domain 'landkreis-musteruckermark-bu.example' — '.example' is a reserved domain that cannot exist on the real internet, which is unusual for a genuine authority letter and worth verifying against the Landkreis's official website before relying on any contact details or the payee IBAN.

The IBAN given for payment (DE92 1705 6060 0001 7291 00) is a well-formed German IBAN, but a valid IBAN does not prove who owns the account; confirm it against an independent, trusted source (e.g. the Landkreis's official website) before paying, especially given the unusual email domain noted above.
